name: hud_ui_transition_text_panel_tick_flash
description: HudUiTransitionTextPanel::Update updates timer visibility and transition text flash state, then draws through HudUiPanel::Draw when the panel remains drawable.
known_limits: Tier C only; Binary Ninja still reports x87 flag-generation limitations around the timer comparison, and tier S comparison is deferred to the transition text panel source-file cluster.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x4bc9f0 validates the hidden-panel early return, timer decrement and SetVisible ftable slot 0x60 dispatch on expiry, flashEnabled/hidden draw fallback, flashCountdown decrement, flashMode 0/1 countdown wrap and direction toggle, flashMode 2/3 color swap, textDirty writes, and HudUiPanel::Draw calls.

The native smoke verifies hidden skip, virtual SetVisible on timer expiry, draw fallback, mode 0 double-draw fallthrough behavior, mode 1 expired no-draw/toggle state, mode 2 color swap, textDirty rebuild through panel draw, and countdown/direction updates.
